mentions.name: AEGIS (Adaptive Execution & Generative Intelligence System)
mentions.description: Self-hosted agentic operating system running on a single workstation with a consumer GPU. Uses a three-tier model cascade: a cloud model handles architecture and reviews diffs with approval authority but never executes directly, a local 32B model handles execution and code generation, and smaller local models handle evaluation. Features include distributed-lock GPU arbitration across competing inference services, read-only access to institutional memory so local models have context before task execution, and autonomous server fleet provisioning. Planned additions are department-based task queues (infrastructure, client consulting, internal tooling) and idle-time priority advisories, aiming for a Jarvis-like assistant rather than a chatbot.
mentions.problem: Local models 'fly blind' without context before executing tasks, and competing inference services contend for the same GPU resources.
mentions.audience: The builder's own personal assistant use — anticipating what the user needs rather than waiting to be asked
